senses.gloss:
डलक डलक or डल्लक, अम्, n. a sling, a
basket, a Dūlī carried on men's shoulders by means
of a stick and ropes like the beam and strings of a
balance, (presents of fruit, sweetmeats, &c., are usu-
ally sent in this manner); (अस्), m., N. of a man.

डलन डलन or डल्लन, अस्, m., N. of a
scholiast on the medical work of Su-śruta.

डालिम डालिम, अस्, m. = दाडिम, a pome-
granate.
